title: The acute effect of different NAD+ precursors included in the combined metabolic activators.
intervention: Combined Metabolic Activators (CMAs) containing NAD+ precursors (nicotinamide riboside [NR], nicotinamide mononucleotide [NMN])
design: double-blind, placebo-controlled one-day human clinical study (global metabolomics)

outcomes.name: NAD+ levels
outcomes.effect_text: CMAs with Nam, NMN as well as NR can be administered for boosting NAD+ levels
